exams.name: ABC Biosolids Land Application Operator Certification Exam
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Standardised exam for operators managing biosolids treatment, transport and land application in compliance with 40 CFR Part 503.

exams.name: ABC Industrial Waste Treatment Operator Certification Exam
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Standardised exam for operators of industrial pretreatment and waste treatment systems discharging to publicly owned treatment works.

exams.name: ABC Very Small Water System Operator Certification Exam
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Standardised exam for operators of very small public water systems covering disinfection, monitoring and basic distribution duties.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Collection System Operator Certification Exam — Class I
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Entry-level standardised exam on sewer cleaning, lift station operation, confined space safety and overflow response.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Collection System Operator Certification Exam — Class II
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Second-level standardised exam covering pipeline inspection, inflow and infiltration control and pump station maintenance.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Collection System Operator Certification Exam — Class III
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Advanced standardised exam on collection system hydraulics, rehabilitation planning and supervision of maintenance crews.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Collection System Operator Certification Exam — Class IV
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Highest-level standardised exam for managers of large sewer collection systems and capacity management programmes.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class I
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Entry-level standardised exam on preliminary treatment, lagoons, disinfection and routine wastewater laboratory testing.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class II
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Second-level standardised exam covering activated sludge process control, clarification and solids handling operations.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class III
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Advanced standardised exam on nutrient removal, anaerobic digestion, NPDES permit compliance and process troubleshooting.

exams.name: ABC Wastewater Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class IV
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Highest-level standardised exam for chief operators of large wastewater treatment facilities and advanced treatment processes.

exams.name: ABC Water Distribution Operator Certification Exam — Class I
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Entry-level standardised exam on mains, storage, disinfection residuals and sampling for public water distribution operators.

exams.name: ABC Water Distribution Operator Certification Exam — Class II
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Second-level standardised exam covering hydraulics, pumping, cross-connection control and distribution system maintenance.

exams.name: ABC Water Distribution Operator Certification Exam — Class III
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Advanced standardised exam covering system modelling, water quality regulations and supervision of distribution operations.

exams.name: ABC Water Distribution Operator Certification Exam — Class IV
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Highest-level standardised exam for managers of large distribution systems, covering planning, budgeting and regulatory compliance.

exams.name: ABC Water Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class I
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Entry-level standardised exam on treatment process monitoring, laboratory analysis and drinking water regulation compliance.

exams.name: ABC Water Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class II
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Second-level standardised exam covering coagulation, filtration, disinfection control and treatment process adjustment.

exams.name: ABC Water Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class III
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Advanced standardised exam on plant optimisation, membrane and advanced treatment processes and regulatory reporting.

exams.name: ABC Water Treatment Operator Certification Exam — Class IV
exams.body: Association of Boards of Certification (Water Professionals International)
exams.blurb: Highest-level standardised exam for chief operators of large surface water treatment plants and complex treatment trains.

exams.name: ABPA Backflow Prevention Assembly Tester Certification
exams.blurb: Alternative tester certification recognised by many water purveyors for annual testing of backflow prevention assemblies.

exams.name: ASSE 5110 Backflow Prevention Assembly Tester Certification
exams.blurb: Written and practical certification for technicians field-testing reduced pressure, double check and pressure vacuum breaker assemblies.

exams.name: ASSE 5120 Backflow Prevention Assembly Repairer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for technicians who disassemble, repair and retest backflow prevention assemblies after a failed field test.

exams.name: Certified Erosion and Sediment Control Lead
exams.blurb: Construction stormwater certification for site leads who inspect erosion controls and sample discharges under general permits.

exams.name: Certified Erosion, Sediment and Storm Water Inspector
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors verifying erosion, sediment and stormwater control installation and maintenance on construction sites.

exams.name: Certified Professional in Erosion and Sediment Control
exams.blurb: Certification recognising expertise in soil erosion processes, sediment control design and construction site stormwater compliance.

exams.name: Certified Professional in Municipal Stormwater Management
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals administering MS4 permit programmes, illicit discharge detection and municipal stormwater planning.

exams.name: Certified Professional in StormWater Quality
exams.blurb: Certification covering watershed hydrology, pollutant transport and design of stormwater quality treatment and mitigation measures.

exams.name: Certified Water Technologist
exams.blurb: Certification for industrial water treatment professionals covering boilers, cooling towers, corrosion control and Legionella risk.

exams.name: Cross-Connection Control Surveyor Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for personnel surveying premises for cross-connections and specifying the correct backflow protection assemblies.

exams.name: National Green Infrastructure Certification Program
exams.blurb: Entry-level certification for workers constructing and maintaining bioretention, permeable paving and other green infrastructure.

exams.name: NAWT Onsite Wastewater Inspector Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors evaluating septic tanks, drainfields and other onsite wastewater systems at property transfer.

exams.name: NAWT Onsite Wastewater Installer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification covering site evaluation, tank setting, drainfield construction and start-up of onsite wastewater treatment systems.

exams.name: NGWA Certified Pump Installer
exams.blurb: Voluntary national certification for contractors installing and servicing water well pumps, pitless units and pressure systems.

exams.name: NGWA Certified Well Driller
exams.blurb: Voluntary national certification examining drilling methods, well construction standards, grouting and groundwater protection.

exams.name: NGWA Master Ground Water Contractor
exams.blurb: Advanced NGWA credential requiring both drilling and pump installation certification plus extensive documented field experience.

exams.name: WQA Certified Installer
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals installing point-of-use and point-of-entry water treatment equipment to plumbing code requirements.

exams.name: WQA Certified Service Technician
exams.blurb: Certification for field technicians troubleshooting and servicing residential point-of-use and point-of-entry treatment systems.

exams.name: WQA Certified Water Specialist
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals specifying multistage treatment trains for residential problem water and health-related contaminants.

exams.name: WQA Certified Water Treatment Representative
exams.blurb: Core certification for representatives selling and configuring treatment options for aesthetic drinking water problems.

exams.name: WQA Master Water Specialist
exams.blurb: Advanced WQA credential requiring existing CWS certification, five years of experience and two advanced-level examinations.

exams.name: Associate Fisheries Professional
exams.blurb: Entry-level certification for fisheries graduates who meet academic requirements but have not yet accrued professional experience.

exams.name: Associate Wildlife Biologist
exams.blurb: Entry-level certification for wildlife graduates meeting coursework requirements before accruing the experience needed for CWB.

exams.name: Certified Crop Adviser
exams.blurb: North American certification requiring international and local board exams in nutrient, soil, pest and water management.

exams.name: Certified Crop Adviser 4R Nutrient Management Specialty
exams.blurb: Specialty credential for Certified Crop Advisers demonstrating expertise in right source, rate, time and place nutrient stewardship.

exams.name: Certified Ecologist
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed professional certification recognising education and experience in applied and academic ecological practice.

exams.name: Certified Environmental Professional
exams.body: Academy of Board Certified Environmental Professionals (ABCEP)
exams.blurb: Board certification recognising senior practitioners in environmental assessment, planning, documentation and management.

exams.name: Certified Fisheries Professional
exams.blurb: Professional certification recognising fisheries scientists who meet coursework and experience standards in fisheries management.

exams.name: Certified Forester
exams.blurb: National credential requiring a forestry degree, qualifying experience and an examination on silviculture, measurement and management.

exams.name: Certified Professional Agronomist
exams.blurb: Certification for degreed agronomists covering crop production, soil fertility, pest management and environmental stewardship.

exams.name: Certified Professional in Rangeland Management
exams.blurb: Certification for rangeland professionals covering ecological site inventory, grazing management and rangeland improvement practice.

exams.name: Certified Professional Soil Scientist
exams.blurb: Certification requiring the Fundamentals of Soil Science exam plus professional practice experience in soil classification and use.

exams.name: Certified Wildlife Biologist
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed certification confirming academic coursework and at least five years of professional wildlife biology experience.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Agricultural Pest Control (Animal)
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Federal category covering pesticide use on livestock and other animals, including treatment of premises and animal facilities.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Agricultural Pest Control (Plant)
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Federal category covering pesticide application to agricultural crops, pastures, orchards and other production plant sites.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Antimicrobial Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Category covering restricted use antimicrobial products applied for disinfection and sanitation in industrial and institutional settings.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Aquatic Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Federal category for applicators treating standing or running water for aquatic weeds, algae and other aquatic pests.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Demonstration and Research Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Category for extension agents and researchers demonstrating pesticide techniques or conducting field trials with restricted use products.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Forest Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Federal category for applicators treating forests, forest nurseries and forest seed-producing areas with restricted use pesticides.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Fumigation
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Category covering soil, structural and commodity fumigation, including monitoring, sealing and re-entry requirements for fumigants.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Ornamental and Turf Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Federal category for applicators treating ornamental trees, shrubs, flowers and turf in landscape and lawn-care settings.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Public Health Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Category for government applicators managing mosquitoes, ticks and other vectors of public health importance.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Regulatory Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Category for state and federal employees applying pesticides during quarantine, eradication and other regulatory pest programmes.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Right-of-Way Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Federal category for vegetation management along roadsides, railways, pipelines and electric transmission rights-of-way.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Seed Treatment
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Federal category covering the treatment of seeds with restricted use pesticides, including handling and worker protection controls.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Structural Pest Control
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
aka: Industrial, Institutional, Structural and Health Related
exams.blurb: Category for applicators controlling pests in and around buildings, including termites, rodents and other structural pests.

exams.name: Commercial Pesticide Applicator — Wood Preservation
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Category covering pressure and non-pressure treatment of wood products with restricted use preservatives at treating facilities.

exams.name: ISA Board Certified Master Arborist
exams.blurb: Highest ISA credential, examining tree science, practice and management for arborists with extensive documented field experience.

exams.name: ISA Certified Arborist
exams.blurb: Core arboriculture certification covering tree biology, pruning, diagnosis, soil management, safety and tree risk fundamentals.

exams.name: ISA Certified Arborist Municipal Specialist
exams.blurb: Specialty credential for arborists managing public urban forests, tree ordinances, inventories and community forestry programmes.

exams.name: ISA Certified Arborist Utility Specialist
exams.blurb: Specialty credential for arborists managing vegetation around electric utility lines, covering clearance standards and outage prevention.

exams.name: ISA Certified Tree Worker Aerial Lift Specialist
exams.blurb: Skills and written certification for tree workers operating aerial lifts safely during pruning and removal operations.

exams.name: ISA Certified Tree Worker Climber Specialist
exams.blurb: Written and practical certification testing climbing systems, aerial rescue, chainsaw use and rigging for production tree workers.

exams.name: ISA Tree Risk Assessment Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification course and assessment on the systematic tree risk assessment process, likelihood matrices and mitigation options.

exams.name: Pesticide Applicator Core Certification Exam
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Core examination based on the national applicator manual covering labels, personal protection, calibration and environmental hazards.

exams.name: Private Pesticide Applicator Certification
exams.body: State Lead Agencies under U.S. EPA 40 CFR Part 171
exams.blurb: Certification allowing farmers and ranchers to buy and apply restricted use pesticides on land they own, rent or manage.

exams.name: Professional Wetland Scientist
exams.body: Society of Wetland Scientists Professional Certification Program
exams.blurb: Certification for wetland delineators and scientists documenting education and experience in hydrology, soils and wetland vegetation.

exams.name: Registered Environmental Manager
exams.blurb: Registry credential for managers of environmental compliance programmes covering air, water, waste and remediation regulations.

exams.name: Registered Environmental Professional
exams.blurb: Broad registry credential recognising practitioners working across environmental science, compliance and site assessment fields.

exams.name: Aboveground Storage Tank Operator Training
exams.body: State Environmental Agencies under U.S. EPA SPCC Rule
exams.blurb: Training on inspection, spill prevention and recordkeeping duties for personnel responsible for aboveground petroleum storage tanks.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Abatement Contractor/Supervisor Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: Five-day AHERA accreditation for competent persons supervising asbestos abatement crews, containments and clearance procedures.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Abatement Worker Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: Four-day initial accreditation required for workers performing asbestos removal, encapsulation and enclosure inside regulated areas.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Building Inspector Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: AHERA accreditation for personnel who survey buildings, identify suspect asbestos-containing materials and collect bulk samples.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Management Planner Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: AHERA accreditation for professionals who interpret inspection results and write asbestos management plans for school and public buildings.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Project Designer Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: AHERA accreditation for designers who specify containment, engineering controls and work practices for asbestos abatement projects.

exams.name: Council-certified Indoor Environmental Consultant
exams.blurb: Board certification for consultants who investigate indoor air quality complaints and write remediation protocols for buildings.

exams.name: Council-certified Indoor Environmentalist
exams.blurb: Entry-level board certification covering indoor air quality assessment, ventilation evaluation and common building contaminants.

exams.name: Council-certified Microbial Consultant
exams.blurb: Advanced board certification for consultants who design mould remediation protocols and verify post-remediation clearance.

exams.name: Council-certified Microbial Investigator
exams.blurb: Board certification for investigators who inspect buildings for mould growth, moisture intrusion and microbial contamination.

exams.name: EPA Brownfields Environmental Job Training Program
exams.blurb: Grant-funded programme combining HAZWOPER, lead, asbestos and site-assessment training for workers entering brownfields remediation.

exams.name: EPA Lead Abatement Project Designer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for designers preparing lead abatement project specifications and occupant-protection plans under 40 CFR Part 745.

exams.name: EPA Lead Abatement Supervisor Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for supervisors directing lead-based paint abatement crews, containment and clearance testing in target housing.

exams.name: EPA Lead Abatement Worker Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for workers performing permanent removal or enclosure of lead-based paint hazards in housing and child-occupied facilities.

exams.name: EPA Lead Dust Sampling Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for technicians collecting lead dust-wipe clearance samples following renovation or abatement in target housing.

exams.name: EPA Lead Renovation, Repair and Painting Renovator Certification
exams.blurb: Eight-hour certification required for renovators disturbing lead paint in pre-1978 homes and child-occupied facilities under the RRP Rule.

exams.name: EPA Lead Risk Assessor Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals performing lead risk assessments, hazard screens and recommendations for interim controls or abatement.

exams.name: EPA Lead-Based Paint Inspector Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors conducting surface-by-surface lead-based paint inspections using XRF analysers and paint chip sampling.

exams.name: IICRC Applied Microbial Remediation Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering containment, engineering controls and cleaning methods used in mould and sewage remediation projects.

exams.name: IICRC Water Damage Restoration Technician
exams.body: Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC)
exams.blurb: Certification covering water intrusion categories, psychrometry and structural drying procedures used in restoration work.

exams.name: NIOSH 582 Equivalency Asbestos Air Sampling Course
aka: Sampling and Evaluating Airborne Asbestos Dust
exams.blurb: Course qualifying technicians to collect and analyse airborne asbestos fibre samples using NIOSH 7400 phase-contrast microscopy methods.

exams.name: NORMI Certified Mold Assessor
exams.body: National Organization of Remediators and Mold Inspectors (NORMI)
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors who assess moisture and microbial growth in buildings and prepare independent remediation protocols.

exams.name: NORMI Certified Mold Remediator
exams.body: National Organization of Remediators and Mold Inspectors (NORMI)
exams.blurb: Certification for contractors performing mould remediation with containment, negative air and post-remediation verification steps.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Measurement Field Technician
exams.blurb: Certification for technicians who deploy and retrieve radon measurement devices under the oversight of a measurement professional.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Measurement Professional
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals conducting radon testing with analytical or passive devices and managing quality-assurance procedures.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Mitigation Installer
exams.blurb: Certification for installers building soil depressurisation systems under the supervision of a certified radon mitigation specialist.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Mitigation Specialist
exams.blurb: Certification for specialists who evaluate radon results and design, install and diagnose radon reduction systems to ANSI-AARST standards.

exams.name: NRSB Radon Measurement Specialist
exams.blurb: Alternative EPA-recognised credential for individuals performing residential and commercial radon measurement services.

exams.name: NRSB Radon Mitigation Specialist
exams.blurb: Alternative EPA-recognised credential for individuals designing and installing radon reduction systems in existing buildings.

exams.name: Phase I Environmental Site Assessment Environmental Professional Training
exams.blurb: Training on All Appropriate Inquiries and ASTM E1527 practice for professionals conducting Phase I environmental site assessments.

exams.name: Underground Storage Tank Class A Operator Certification
exams.body: State UST Programs under U.S. EPA Energy Policy Act Rules
exams.blurb: Certification for operators with primary responsibility for underground storage tank regulatory compliance and system operation.

exams.name: Underground Storage Tank Class B Operator Certification
exams.body: State UST Programs under U.S. EPA Energy Policy Act Rules
exams.blurb: Certification for operators who implement day-to-day release detection, spill prevention and recordkeeping at UST facilities.

exams.name: Underground Storage Tank Class C Operator Training
exams.body: State UST Programs under U.S. EPA Energy Policy Act Rules
exams.blurb: Site-level training for staff who respond first to alarms, spills and emergencies at fuelling facilities with underground storage tanks.
